description: This file declares the NetworkInterfaceManager class which provides mechanisms to access and manage network interfaces, including opening existing interfaces and applying changes. It serves as an interface for managing network interfaces, encapsulating related functionality and dependencies such as NetlinkClient.

classes.name: NetworkInterfaceManager
classes.description: Provides access to network interfaces, allowing opening existing interfaces and applying configuration changes. It can create new instances via the static factory method and manages backend connections through NetlinkClient.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens an existing network interface by name, returning a NetworkInterface object. Does not populate interface details.

methods.name: ApplyChanges
methods.description: Applies configuration changes to an existing NetworkInterface object. Cannot create new interfaces.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new NetworkInterfaceManager instance with a specified NetlinkClientFactory.
